description: Defines a generic, immutable three-tuple (triplet) data structure with methods for creation, access, and equality checks.

classes.name: TriTuple
classes.description: An immutable generic class representing a tuple of three values of arbitrary types, with methods for creation, access, and equality.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new TriTuple instance with specified values.

methods.name: one
methods.description: Returns the first element of the tuple.

methods.name: two
methods.description: Returns the second element of the tuple.

methods.name: three
methods.description: Returns the third element of the tuple.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the TriTuple.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on the tuple's elements.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on tuple elements.
